sloka: त्वय्यस्ति तु मम स्नेहः परा सम्भावना च मे ।दैवासुरेषु युद्धेषु बहुशो राक्षसर्षभ ।त्वया देवाः प्रतिव्यूह्य निर्जिताश्चासुरा युधि ।। ६.६२.२१ ।।
transliteration: tvayyasti tu mama snehaḥ parā sambhāvanā ca me ।daivāsureṣu yuddheṣu bahuśo rākṣasarṣabha ।tvayā devāḥ prativyūhya nirjitāścāsurā yudhi ।। 6.62.21 ।।

translations.english: "O Bull among Rakshasas! Being my brother, do this for me. I always have affection for you. Considering that you have encountered war with Devas and Asuras and won both Devas and Asuras, do this help."
